THEY ALL SUCK!|audio = NullVoidNight3Wave29-5.ogg|[[Narrator (Narrator)|Narrator]] on Wave 29 ([[Blind Faith]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Star Cannon''' is an interactable map object in the [[Blind Faith]] map as part of the [[Null & Void Event]], and also has previously appeared in [[Totality Tower]] as part of the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. The '''Star Cannon's''' main purpose is to stop [[The Umbra]] and [[Rift Walker]] from performing their abilities which, if not prevented, damage the base health and potentially kill the player. For both events it required three [[Charge (Item)|Charges]]. To use the '''Star Cannon''' in the [[Null & Void Event]], players must first collect eight '''Star Cannon''' parts scattered around the map, available from Wave 7. Shards starts at {{Money|500}} and increases by {{Money|500}} with each subsequent shard, for a total of {{Money|18,000}}. Once completed, it takes three [[Charge (Item)|Charges]] to fire. These fall down from the sky, but only if the '''Star Cannon''' is not fully loaded. Its main use is to stop the [[Rift Walker]] from performing its ''Lord Exo's Rebirth'' ability, though it can also be used to deal 1,000 damage to an enemy per use. In the [[Solar Eclipse Event]], its mechanics were similar — the '''Star Cannon''' would fire at [[The Umbra]] when activated by the player, stunning it. Similarly, it required three [[Charge (Item)|Charges]] to fire and had a 60-second cooldown. [[Charge (Item)|Charges]] could be collected from around the map. During this event, its main use was to prevent [[The Umbra]] from using its ''Shot of the Century'' ability, which would damage the base otherwise. ==Appearance== The '''Star Cannon''' is a large white, yellow, grey and dark grey cannon. It had a yellow star on the side and a neon light on top of it.During the [[Null & Void Event]] in the [[Blind Faith]] map, it was located near the exit. During the [[Solar Eclipse Event]], It always faced [[The Umbra]] even if it was not charged. It was attached on top of the exit. ==Strategy== *While available to rebuild from Wave 7, it is not recommended to actually rebuild it this early as the '''Star Cannon''' serves very little use early on. **It is best bought around five waves before Wave 30. *The [[Rift Walker]] will have [[Lord Exo]] come out of its body while also turning the entire map yellow, this is when the player should be using the '''Star Cannon'''. **It is recommended to prevent the ability every time, as the ability only requires two successful uses to end the match. **[[The Fool]] reduces this further to one successful shot. If no one in the team can time the '''Star Cannon''' well, [[The Fool]] is best avoided. *In the Easy difficulty of [[Blind Faith]], it is actually entirely possible to not purchase the '''Star Cannon''', especially if the player has overheal from [[Skills]], which allows them to tank more shots. ==Trivia== *The '''Star Cannon''' was inspired from the [https://terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/Star_Cannon Star Cannon] from ''Terraria'' and the [https://battlecats.miraheze.org/wiki/Cat_Cannon#Cannon_Types Thunderbolt Cat Cannon] from ''Battle Cats''. *This and the [[Charge (Item)|Charges]] were the first interactable objects inside a match. *It was possible to get stuck on a certain part near the top of the cannon. *The '''Star Cannon''' appears in the 2025 Halloween lobby event area and as one of the falling props in [[Banlands]]. ==Update History== *'''13 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]]g **'''Star Cannon''' added. *'''26 January 2022''' - [[v1.0.1]] **'''Star Cannon''' removed. *'''1 November 2025''' - [[v1.79.0]] **'''Star Cannon''' re-added. {{InteractableNavBox}}
